product_brief: A low SWaP, ruggedized IFF crypto appliqué for UAVs supporting Mode 5 and NSA CM2 quantum-resistant requirements.
pqc_support: Yes — KIV-80 enables quantum resistant security per NSA requirements for software protection and algorithms.
pqc_capability_description: The device is designed to meet Crypto Modernization 2.0 (CM2) and is described as "NSA CM2 Quantum Resistant Compliant." It supports re-programmable algorithms and is upgradeable with the Advanced INFOSEC Adapter for Legacy Crypto Replacement Machine (AIM) III crypto processor. Specific PQC algorithm names (e.g., ML-KEM, ML-DSA) are not listed.
key_management_model: Hardware key storage with black keys (3 months duration) and key recovery; key fill via DS-101 or SKL; supports Cold Fill capability.
regulatory_status: Under NSA certification evaluation as KIV-80; submitted to NSA for certification 1Q 2026
pqc_roadmap_details: Designed to meet Crypto Modernization 2.0 (CM2); NSA certification evaluation submitted for 1Q 2026.
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Designed for SWaP-constrained platforms; dimensions 2.5” W x 2.55” D x 0.8” H; weight 4.25 ounces; power 1100 mW nominal; battery life 8 years nominal.
